{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99) and refunded orders
data_filtered = data[(data['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) & (data['status'] == 'completed')]

# Confirm QA rows were removed
print("Number of rows with revenue_clean == 999999.99 after filtering:", (data_filtered['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).sum())

# Final check: no QA or refunded orders in filtered data
print("Number of refunded orders in filtered data:", (data_filtered['status'] == 'refunded').sum())"}
